description: Defines structures, function prototypes, and constants for handling reftable records, including string views, varint encoding/decoding, record vtable, and record management functions.

methods.name: string_view_consume
methods.description: Advances the buffer pointer by n bytes and decreases its length.

methods.name: reftable_record_init
methods.description: Initializes a reftable_record with a specified type.

methods.name: reftable_record_equal
methods.description: Checks if two reftable_records are equal.

methods.name: reftable_record_key
methods.description: Extracts the key from a reftable_record.

methods.name: reftable_record_copy_from
methods.description: Copies data from one reftable_record to another.

methods.name: reftable_record_val_type
methods.description: Returns the value type of a reftable_record.

methods.name: reftable_record_encode
methods.description: Encodes a reftable_record into a string view.

methods.name: reftable_record_decode
methods.description: Decodes data into a reftable_record from a string view.

methods.name: reftable_record_is_deletion
methods.description: Checks if a reftable_record is a tombstone (deletion).

methods.name: reftable_record_release
methods.description: Frees and zeroes out a reftable_record.
